content.thinking:
Given the notice date of 10 October, tenants need to give 2 months' notice under the Act, so the earliest possible end date would be 10 December 2026, unless the landlord agrees in writing to a shorter period.

If an earlier move-out is wanted, options include the landlord agreeing to an earlier date, a mutual surrender, or the tenant finding a replacement occupant — ultimately it's the landlord's call. I shouldn't promise anything about the deposit, since that's only returned after check-out through the proper scheme process, and keys shouldn't be handed over before the agreed end date. For actions, I'll reply to the tenant with this information and request landlord approval for any shorter end date, keeping things simple without needing a formal escalation.

arguments.body:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for letting us know, and congratulations on the new job. Under the current rules a tenant needs to give two months' written notice, so one month isn't enough to end the tenancy on 10 November. Your notice dated 10 October would run to 10 December 2026, and rent stays payable until then.

A shorter date is only possible if your landlord agrees in writing. We're asking him now and will email you by Wednesday 14 October with his answer. Please don't treat 10 November as agreed until you have that in writing. If you'd like to suggest an alternative date, or have someone who could take over the flat, tell us.

Keys: please don't drop them anywhere yet. We'll confirm the handover date, place and a check-out appointment once your end date is settled.

Deposit: it's protected with mydeposits. After you move out and we've checked the flat, we'll let you know about any proposed deductions and return the rest. We can't give a date until the end date is fixed.

Kind regards,
Mare & Co Lettings

arguments.decision_needed: Tom Achterberg (Flat 2, 5 Navarino Road) gave one month's notice on 10 Oct 2026 to leave on 10 Nov. This is not valid under the Renters' Rights Act (two months needed), so the earliest date is 10 Dec 2026. Do you agree in writing to an earlier end date of 10 Nov 2026? Rent would stop then and we would start re-letting and check-out arrangements.
options: Hold to 10 December 2026 (the legal minimum) - recommended if you want rent cover
Agree another date between 10 Nov and 10 Dec

content.thinking:
Given the notice date of 10 October, tenants need to give 2 months' notice under the Act, so the earliest possible end date would be 10 December 2026, unless the landlord agrees in writing to a shorter period.

If an earlier move-out is wanted, options include the landlord agreeing to an earlier date, a mutual surrender, or the tenant finding a replacement occupant — ultimately it's the landlord's call. I shouldn't promise anything about the deposit, since that's only returned after check-out through the proper scheme process, and keys shouldn't be handed over before the agreed end date. For actions, I'll reply to the tenant with this information and request landlord approval for any shorter end date, keeping things simple without needing a formal escalation.

arguments.body:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for letting us know, and congratulations on the new job. Under the current rules a tenant needs to give two months' written notice, so one month isn't enough to end the tenancy on 10 November. Your notice dated 10 October would run to 10 December 2026, and rent stays payable until then.

A shorter date is only possible if your landlord agrees in writing. We're asking him now and will email you by Wednesday 14 October with his answer. Please don't treat 10 November as agreed until you have that in writing. If you'd like to suggest an alternative date, or have someone who could take over the flat, tell us.

Keys: please don't drop them anywhere yet. We'll confirm the handover date, place and a check-out appointment once your end date is settled.

Deposit: it's protected with mydeposits. After you move out and we've checked the flat, we'll let you know about any proposed deductions and return the rest. We can't give a date until the end date is fixed.

Kind regards,
Mare & Co Lettings

Rent would stop then and we would start re-letting and check-out arrangements.
options: Hold to 10 December 2026 (the legal minimum) - recommended if you want rent cover
Agree another date between 10 Nov and 10 Dec
